title: Sharp Convergence Domains for Cluster Expansions
exact_target: Find the exact convergence region and sharp usable convergence criteria for polymer cluster expansions.

status_qualification: The graph and partition-function notation were recovered from PDF pages 15--17. The report already proves a sufficient Dobrushin condition: some $r:V\to[0,1)$ satisfies $R(v)\leq r(v)\prod_{v'\in N(v)}(1-r(v'))$. The inherited question about exact and sharp domains is broader than this established sufficient bound; it is not an assertion that the report leaves all convergence unexplained.
